facts.fact: NITDA says it launched a capacity-building programme for civil servants at the Office of the Head of the Civil Service, training champions from 43 MDAs on the DISCO learning platform for a Cisco-backed online course.
NITDA says the Head of the Civil Service stated all civil servants are required to complete the Cisco-backed online course within two months, with progress tracked across ministries.

systems.platform: Cisco Networking Academy / DISCO learning platform
